scope: Source/log audit of installed LiveKit Agents 1.8.3 and PRISM room-job lifecycle. No model/service launches.

iteration5_observed.limit: Termination occurred while drain waited. No blocked per-job stack is available; the log does not establish that every requested session teardown completed. No connection to the earlier telemetry stall is inferred.

source_chain.finding: The linked participant leaving with CLIENT_INITIATED, ROOM_DELETED or USER_REJECTED requests session close. This does not disconnect the agent room. Default delete_room_on_close is false.

Session.start registers job-shutdown to session-close. Session closure emits close after activity teardown and _started=False, without requesting JobContext shutdown. RoomIO only optionally deletes the room on close.

Connected entrypoint return leaves the job awaiting shutdown_fut. Agent room disconnected, ctx.shutdown, entrypoint crash or parent shutdown can resolve it; remote participant departure alone does not.
Worker drain stops accepting new work and waits current executor.join; it sends no shutdown request. The production CLI reaches server.aclose after draining or timeout.
Thread executor aclose sends shutdown, warns on timeouts, but subsequently awaits shutdown/thread completion without a final bound. Shorter drain_timeout does not bound native thread completion.

minimal_change_review.candidate: Before session.start register close -> set closing and call synchronous ctx.shutdown(reason). Keep cleanup in the existing job callback; suppress session_started if close happened during start and log cleanup start/end.
minimal_change_review.no_lock_cycle_found: ctx.shutdown resolves an SDK future and returns. Session emits close under its lock after _started=False. SDK shutdown later awaits session.aclose, proceeds after lock release and finds it closed. SDK suppresses repeat shutdown-future resolution.
minimal_change_review.cleanup_sequence: SDK waits entrypoint completion, closes primary session (60s SDK timeout), runs session reporting, disconnects room, then concurrently awaits shutdown callbacks. Registration order is not a sequencing guarantee.
minimal_change_review.drain_decision: Keep 3600s unchanged for comparison. Deleting the room is broader than ending this agent job. Shorter drain alone hides the missing lifecycle bridge and cannot guarantee thread shutdown.
limits: The handler runs after activity teardown emits close; it does not repair teardown stuck before that event.
Appropriate for this one-session-per-job entrypoint; intentional session restart within one job requires a different policy.
Native work, SDK reporting or callbacks can still block. No general bounded worker-exit claim follows.

regression_evidence.method: Whole production entrypoint executed via AST with lightweight SDK fakes and real Coordinator/Executor; no LiveKit/audio/model imports. Fakes mirror inspected closure ordering and lock, without proving SDK runtime behavior.

after_checkpoint.scope: Root-run lifecycle, coordinator and asynchronous telemetry focused tests. No duplicate audit test launch.

assertions: Participant, error and job-shutdown closes request job shutdown and preserve reason; repeat-close is idempotent.
SDK-modeled cleanup cancels planning/publishing, closes client and trace, rejects late user turns.
Close during session.start is observed; another room remains live.

checks: Retain every capture/effect outcome. After recorder exits, observe its owned room for agent departure for up to 10s without deleting room.
Correlate participant disconnect, per-room cleanup start/end, remaining agent presence and worker/job logs.
After all trials SIGTERM worker using unchanged 20s outer grace and 3600s SDK drain; preserve exit code and any escalation.
Report room departure, process exit, content/effects and trace completeness separately.
live_validation_protocol.status: Protocol reviewed; live outcomes not measured or claimed by this audit.
